item.tib: gsas mkhar g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las
item.coloph: dus dang las kyis dbang bsgyur te/ gter ma rnam gnyis ma byon kyang / dran pa nyid kyis thugs bcud bsdus/ skal par ldan bslob (slob) bu de/ bsnyon (smon) pa dus mtha'i rnal 'byor la/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ dben pa'i gnas su bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud/ bdag gis gsang sbas thub par byas/ mtshan ldan bla mas legs par bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong bstan srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun bla med sa thob shog bkra shis 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam shog/
